answer: Gate every new identity through one narrow admission inlet: a newcomer must be sponsored by an established agent who stakes a bond that is slashed if the newcomer cheats, and each sponsor's slots regrow slowly, like water seeping through layers of shale. A sponsor can vouch for only a few newcomers per season, so to forge a thousand fakes an attacker must recruit a thousand willing sponsors or wait years for slots to refill — while one honest agent needs a single sponsor, once.
